description: Reduce the number of coordinates in a polyline while keeping its shape (Douglas-Peucker). `tolerance_deg` is in DEGREES, not metres: about 0.0001 drops detail finer than roughly 10 m at the equator. Endpoints are always kept. Returns the retained points and how many were removed. Local computation: no network call, no quota.

LatLon.description: A WGS84 coordinate in decimal degrees: a {lat, lon} object (preferred), or a GeoJSON [lon, lat] array with LONGITUDE FIRST, the same order as every polygon field on this server.

tolerance_deg.description:
Douglas-Peucker tolerance in **degrees**, not metres. Around
0.0001 drops detail finer than roughly 10 m at the equator.
